interpretation: The new evidence materially improves confidence that Qwen3.8-27B is practical on Strix Halo. MTP can substantially raise decode throughput when configured well, but community results also show sensitivity to backend, quantization and speculative-decoding settings. R9700 remains substantially faster in AMD's vendor test, while Strix Halo trades speed for unified-memory capacity and lower platform power.
